correctness.rationale: A contiguous flip crosses at most two bond boundaries. The exact energy-change identity makes every wall of an r-stable state an endpoint-separated strict radius-r bond minimum, and conversely every subset of those minima is stable against all r-site flip sets. This gives 2^(M+1) exactly. Iid atomless rank invariance gives p=1/(2r+1); 2r-dependence yields an a.s. entropy and CLT. Direct conditioning yields joint probability 2/[(2r+1)(2r+1+d)] for r<d<=2r, giving the explicit strictly positive variance. Exact finite Hamiltonian and permutation checks ran successfully; these are supportive only.

value.rationale: Stability to simultaneous cooperative flips is physically motivated for finite cluster activation. The all-r exact classification identifies a universal extensive metastable entropy log(2)/(2r+1) with nonzero explicit quenched Gaussian variance, while budgets proportional to system size give a discrete two-point count. This establishes distinct static metastable regimes in an unfrustrated disordered spin chain, beyond a one-parameter numerical enumeration.
